hook.say: Turkey shares a border with eight countries. Here are five of them. Can you name each one from its shape?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Greece has the longest coastline in the Mediterranean.
questions.sayAnswer: Greece! It has the longest coastline in the Mediterranean.

questions.fact: Iran was officially known as Persia in the West until 1935.
questions.sayAnswer: Iran! It was officially known as Persia in the West until 1935.

questions.fact: Iraq: both the Tigris and the Euphrates flow through it.
questions.sayAnswer: Iraq! Both the Tigris and the Euphrates flow through it.

questions.fact: Bulgaria: its Rose Valley is one of the world's top sources of rose oil.
questions.sayAnswer: Bulgaria! Its Rose Valley is one of the world's top sources of rose oil.

questions.fact: Georgia: people have been making wine here for about 8,000 years.
questions.sayAnswer: Georgia! People have been making wine here for about 8000 years.
